verdict.rationale: Error tracking is a fair axis for an APM product, but the evidence pack never documents grouping application errors into issues, viewing stack traces, or detecting regressions. Deployment markers (CLI-recorded APM deployments) are adjacent release-tracking support only and cannot carry the core of the story, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection
